title: Beamhound
summary: Sniffs out your IR remote from one button press and becomes it.
description:
Point any infrared remote at the Cardputer Zero and press Power. Beamhound decodes the signal (NEC, Samsung, RC5/RC6, Sony SIRC, Panasonic/Kaseikyo, RCA, Pioneer and more), finds every matching remote in the community Flipper-IRDB database, then asks only the questions that matter - press another button, pick the brand or device type, or watch whether your TV reacts to a test signal - until it knows your device. Usually one or two questions, often none.

Lost the remote? Search for the brand instead: Beamhound fires that brand's power codes one at a time, most common first, while you press Space; press Enter when the device switches off, and a few quick test signals pin down the exact model.

Then it becomes the remote: power, volume, channels, input, menu, arrows, OK, playback and number keys are mapped to the keyboard (F/Z/X/C arrows, Fn media keys work too), and every other button the remote has is one list away. Matches are saved so your remotes are always on the home screen.

TVs, projectors, AV receivers, soundbars, cable and streaming boxes, disc players, fans and lights are supported (air conditioners are not yet). On first run the app downloads the Flipper-IRDB database (about 17 MB) over Wi-Fi and indexes it on the device.
